verdict.rationale: SerpApi covers the search step well for agents: an official MCP server exposes it as a web search tool, and LLM-optimized markdown output works across every engine. Its Google AI Mode and AI Overview engines return Google's own synthesized answers through the same API. But nothing shows it fetching or extracting the content of result pages, and the community describes adding a separate crawler as an external workaround. Missing for 10: page-content extraction from result URLs, a first-party multi-step research/synthesis endpoint, and hands-on evidence of an end-to-end agent research flow.
